files.name: motion-prompt-081.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Hover lift" (ホバーで浮き上がる), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #081

What it is: On hover, the element rises with a deeper shadow
What the sample shows: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.
Spec:
- Three cards (146 × 128, radius 10). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s.
- On hover the card rises 10 px over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over the same 0.3 s (like a CSS transition).
- Shadow, changed together with the lift: blur 6→22 px, y offset 2→12 px, opacity 0.08→0.22.
- Light grey page, white cards, so the shadow reads.
When to use it: Use it to make cards and buttons look clickable.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/081.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
